capex: no capital-expenditure figure is filed for 10 period(s) with operating cash flow (2024-03-31..2026-06-30); free cash flow and owner's earnings are blank there (capex is never read as zero)

restricted cash: in 3 period(s), 2019-12-31..2020-09-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 1 period, 2019-12-31 it holds no restricted cash (the same date's CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue equals the total, or the restricted-cash figure is 0): nothing deducted, not marked; in 2 period(s), 2020-06-30..2020-09-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 7 period(s) with discontinued operations (2023-12-31..2025-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there

same filing: 2 fiscal-year cell(s) of a derived figure are blank because its inputs' values come from different filing generations (one restated by a later filing, the other as originally filed) although one filing reports them all: fcf_margin 2023-12-31, fcf_margin 2024-12-31

growth across filing generations: 30 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): accounts_payable (2024-12-31); accrued (2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31); cash (2024-12-31); cost_of_revenue (2023-12-31); current_lease (2024-12-31); debt_issued (2021-12-31); deferred_revenue_current (2024-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2024-12-31); deferred_tax_liab (2024-12-31); ebitda (2023-12-31); general_admin (2023-12-31); goodwill (2023-12-31); ...
